from transformers import TFAutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
import tensorflow as tf

model_name = 'bert-base-uncased'
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)

texts = train_data.astype(str).tolist()
enc = tokenizer(texts, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=128, return_tensors='tf')
labels = tf.convert_to_tensor(train_labels.values, dtype=tf.float32)

clf_model = TFAutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(model_name, num_labels=1)
clf_model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate=2e-5),
                  loss=tf.keras.losses.BinaryCrossentropy(from_logits=True),
                  metrics=['accuracy'])

clf_model.fit(
    {'input_ids': enc['input_ids'], 'attention_mask': enc['attention_mask']},
    labels,
    epochs=1,
    batch_size=8
)
